verdict.rationale: Community evidence confirms Jira supports linking issues across projects/epics to give visibility into dependencies (jira-comm-5), and subtasks/epics are a well-known core Jira feature referenced indirectly via workflow/customization claims (jira-docs-3), but no direct evidence details subtask creation UX, and multiple complaints about confusing UI, broken workflows, and difficulty tracking closed sprints/epics suggest execution is imperfect (jira-comm-8, jira-comm-17).
